text:
remy: Kickoff: brief entitlement squeeze starting now (11:00 PT). Scope: admin roles dormant >60d, KMS grants with any non-org principals, and service accounts referenced only in cron metadata. Evidence-only run; no auto-revokes.
sylvia: Thumbs up. Can we surface terraform-tracked bindings separately so infra teams get the first pass?
remy: Yes  pipeline will diff tfstate and tag infra_tracked=true. infra_tracked items route to infra owners first; others go to principal email + access-steward cc.
kevin: For prioritization, let's compute a simple risk score: external_principal * days_since_last_use + infra_untracked_bonus. Put highest score at top of the ticket queue.
access-bot: recert-lite job rl-20261003-01 started at 2026-10-03T18:00:12Z. Scanning IAM bindings, KMS grants, and SA cron-references. Report will post here.
oncall-ops: Heads-up: owner emails sometimes hit oncall aliases and generate noise. Please add header X-Notify-Policy:quiet for known oncall aliases and rate-limit to 40/hr. Add a 1-click "I own" ack in ticket bodies to reduce followups.
policy: If audit log retention is partial for some projects, tag log_coverage=partial so reviewers know to ask for extra evidence instead of revoking.
kevin: Quick gcloud snippet for recent decrypts to include in tickets:
```bash
gcloud logging read 'resource.type="kms_key" AND protoPayload.methodName:"Decrypt"' --limit=100 --freshness=90d --format='value(protoPayload.authenticationInfo.principalEmail, timestamp, resource.labels.key_name)'
```
This should help owners prove active use.
access-bot: collection complete at 2026-10-03T18:04:20Z. Summary: 3,740 bindings scanned, 96 KMS grants, 38 cron-only SAs, 64 admin roles dormant>60d. Creating 112 owner-evidence tickets. Tags: external_principal(27), infra_untracked(44), cron_only(38), log_coverage_partial(9).
sylvia: I'll take the top external_principal keys and ping partner teams before owner emails go out to avoid breaking integrations.
remy: Plan: 1) create tickets now 2) 5-day response window 3) escalate ownerless/high-risk items to oncall for manual review 4) manual revokes only by oncall with runbook checklist. Volunteers: @sylvia partner outreach, @kevin risk-score tuning, @policy ticket template.
policy: I'll add a short ticket template: last-3-actors, infra_tracked flag, log_coverage status, risk_score, and two buttons: [I own this] or [Need help].
oncall-ops: Please ensure the oncall checklist includes: rotation check, dependent-service discovery, and rollback reprovision steps before any revoke. Also add a 10-minute revert automation if alerts spike post-change.
kevin: After owner responses, I'll post a conservative dry-run revoke CSV (exclude cron-only + infra_tracked + rotation_recent) for signoff here. No action until we have explicit signoff.
remy: Thanks team. Ticket summary will appear in #triage tomorrow AM. Closing the loop: evidence-only sweep, prioritized by risk_score, rate-limited notices, and manual remediation path defined. :thumbsup:
